relationships.subject: high-intensity interval training
relationships.evidence_quote: HIIT modulated ferroptosis-related markers, including GPX4 and ACSL4, and upregulated SIRT1 with activation of NRF2 signaling and improved iron metabolism within cartilage

relationships.subject: EX527
relationships.evidence_quote: Pharmacologic inhibition of SIRT1 (EX527) reversed these benefits, underscoring SIRT1's pivotal role in mediating HIIT's therapeutic effects

relationships.subject: SIRT1
relationships.evidence_quote: lentiviral SIRT1 overexpression restored NRF2-GPX4 signaling and decreased TFRC/ACSL4

key_findings: HIIT improves gait and pain thresholds and cartilage repair in MIA rat OA via SIRT1.
In chondrocytes a SIRT1-NRF2-GPX4 axis regulates ferroptosis-associated responses.
